why: Seven vision outputs were generated, but execution success does not establish musical correctness. Independently score the saved outputs against the same pilot baselines and inspect parsing and transposition results.
hypothesis: Direct vision transcription reduces both melody error below 66.9% and chord sequence error below 78.9%, unlike the text-to-harmony intervention, which showed no improvement.
expected_observation: Lower error in both metrics would support the hypothesis; equal or higher error in either would contradict it. Report parse failures and available transposition checks separately. Seven excerpts cannot establish full-set completion, audited chord timing or musician acceptance.
